apiCommitMessage: feat(orders): conectar seguimiento del pedido con la API

architecture.composition: createApplicationRuntime, private authorization session and lazy authenticated transport

existingBackendContractTests.boundary: Existing Nest contract tests with isolated dependencies; not MongoDB production or a physical device

loopbackHttp.transport: node:http ephemeral loopback servers, real HttpClient/Repository/actions/controller, synthetic accounts and data
verified: Two authenticated GETs without body, cookies or user query
Tracking is authoritative for current status
Nullable timestamps remain absent
Network and 503 retain confirmed pair until explicit retry
404 clears former order
401 hides order without changing global Auth
Malformed JSON, IDs and dates fail safely
Changing account aborts and ignores late replies
Node fetch rejects redirects to another origin
limits: Synthetic API is not the running Nest/MongoDB service
Redirect result applies to Node fetch, not every native fetch implementation

webQa.data: Synthetic public session and domain actions injected into real controller, providers, ViewModel and Screen; no real API or account used
verified: Initial loading is distinct from an empty selection
Four order states
Completed without timestamps does not invent confirmation or dates
Cancelled timeline ends without completed
Refresh and network retry preserve then restore the confirmed order
Changing order removes former content before the new response
No selection asks for a history choice
403 and 404 remove former data
401 and logout show only authentication access
No horizontal overflow at 397 or 320 px
Normal route without a session shows login after temporary QA removal

nextStep: User opens Cuenta -> Historial de pedidos -> selected receipt -> Ver seguimiento del pedido in Expo Go, checks real data and Actualizar seguimiento, then reports results. Record native acceptance in its own later commit.
